title: Prospective Registry of Corona Virus Disease 2019 (Covid-19) Patients With Neuromuscular Involvement
brief_summary: Prospective registry for multimodal assessment of neuromuscular pathology associated with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection, enrolling consecutive patients with corona virus disease 2019 (Covid-19), who are admitted to the intensive care unit of the department of anesthesiology and intensive care medicine, or the department of neurology at Tübingen University Hospital.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Proven severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* active or known history of myopathy or advanced stage neuropathy
* refusal to participate in clinical research
study_population: Consecutive patients with corona virus disease 2019 (Covid-19), who are admitted to the intensive care unit of the department of anesthesiology and intensive care medicine, or the department of neurology at Tübingen University Hospital.
